name: Kohonya
source:
There is a quiet antique shop on the corner of the city. If you lost something, you should visit this place. Beyond the door a mysterious girl sits at the counter.
"Welcome to the second-hand bookstore Kohonya".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
城市一角有间安静的古董店。如果遗失了什么，不妨到这里看看。推开门，一名神秘少女正坐在柜台后方。
“欢迎光临旧书店Kohonya。”

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
